messages:
sara: Quick preflight before tomorrow's release — code freeze at 09:00 PT. Please post any late-merge exception requests here by 07:30 PT with PR number, short risk assessment, and test plan. Also confirm version bump ownership for your package. cc @ben @linda :alarm_clock:

ben: Got it. My bump PR is #5234 (runtime). No infra changes. QA smoke on staging passed. @qa-bot basic e2e green.

linda: Changelog note: I still need the tiny wording for `opt-cache` bump — want to avoid implying a breaking change. @omar can you confirm the behavior delta?

omar: Confirming behavior: eviction order changed but API is backwards compatible. Docs updated in #5238. Ran a quick perf run locally — no regression. :thumbsup:

sara: Thanks. Reminder for exception requests: include rollback plan (how to revert), estimated user impact, and who will be oncall to monitor. We'll be strict with approvals.

ryan: Quick: `release/1.7.x` is 2 commits behind `main` — can someone reconcile? I can fast-forward if no objections.

ben: I can handle the merge in ~20m. Will run sanity and tag for CI. Command I’ll use: `git checkout release/1.7.x && git merge --ff-only main && ./tools/ci-trigger.sh --pr 5250`.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: CI pipeline for #5234 — unit: ✔ integration: ✔ canary: running (ETA ~15m)

linda: Exception request: PR #5246 — docs-only but touches API examples. Requesting merge after manual review. Risk: low. Rollback: revert PR. Oncall: linda.

sara: Approved for docs-only. @deploy-bot please kick canary once #5246 is merged. Also a reminder: version bump PRs must include a `CHANGELOG.md` snippet and an author line.

ben: Merged `release/1.7.x` with main; created PR #5250 to update buildstamp. Ran `./scripts/smoke_check.sh` — clean.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary for #5250 completed with no errors. Release window: green.

sara: Thanks all. Final checklist: (1) exceptions posted by 07:30 PT (2) all version bumps include changelog snippet (3) merges to release branch only via approved PRs (4) oncall coverage confirmed. I’ll post a last freeze reminder at 08:45 PT.

omar: Oncall covered by @ryan and @linda for the window.

ryan: Noted — I’ll be available at 09:00 PT for any rollback/monitoring.

sara: Perfect — if anything pops up, drop it here and tag me. Good luck everyone :rocket:
